Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG questionnaire - request and deadline

Team — initial pass completed. I attached the draft answers and annotated the questionnaire where we cannot provide a standard YES. High-level non-standard items:

1) Encryption key custody (Q5.3) — We currently manage encryption keys in a customer-segregated KMS integration for Private deployments, but hosted customers use provider-managed KMS. For Keyframe (enterprise deal) we can offer customer-managed KMS on Dedicated/Private; for hosted that would be a non-standard answer unless they sign up for Dedicated.

2) Audit logging retention (Q8.1) — Our platform currently retains audit logs for 90 days; customer-requested 13-month retention is on the product roadmap for H2 2026.

3) Third-party subprocessors (Q4.2) — We disclose subprocessors in our data processing addendum; however, one new telemetry vendor (MetricsFlow) is integrated for hosted tenants only and requires a narrow exception for Keyframe if they expect no third-party usage.

4) Backup and restore SLA (Q7.4) — We have standard backups with 30-day retention. Extended retention requires dedicated capacity or a contractual add-on.

5) Data residency for EU customers (Q2.6) — Not applicable for this US-only customer, but noting for completeness.

Recommended next steps:
- For items 1 and 2, Product/Engineering to confirm whether we can convert the roadmap item into a firm SPW with timelines and milestones.
- For subprocessors, propose a narrow compensating control (data scoping + contract clause) if Keyframe cannot accept the standard hosted model.
- Legal to prepare SPW template and acceptable wording.

Attachment: Keyframe_SIG_answers_draft.pdf

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG answers draft - roadmap & SPW approach

Thanks Neha — good, thorough work. Quick technical notes:

- Audit logging (Q8.1): Building extended retention and per-tenant export is feasible; we estimate 4-6 sprints to add per-tenant retention controls and export hooks. We can commit to a Statement of Planned Work (SPW) to deliver the feature within a 6-month window with defined milestones, but that is a product commitment and we should be explicit about scope (hosted vs dedicated).

- KMS: Customer-managed keys are supported for Dedicated and Private. For hosted, supporting CMK requires a more expensive hosting tier and extra controls.

- MetricsFlow (telemetry): We can gate telemetry for Keyframe's tenancy via feature flag and a written contract clause — acceptable as a compensating control.

I recommend offering the SPW for audit logging (with milestones), a compensating control for MetricsFlow, and offering extended backups as a commercial add-on. If we go the SPW route, we need explicit executive approval to use product roadmap capacity and to provide the customer with milestone dates.

Vivek
CTO, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec approval for SPW commitment to Keyframe Health (audit logging)

Aditya — quick ask on an active deal (HS-54321). Keyframe's security and procurement teams require a non-standard answer for audit logging retention (they want 13 months). Engineering (Vivek) can deliver an audit-logging retention/export feature within ~6 months, and Security recommends offering a Statement of Planned Work (SPW) that commits to milestones.

Proposed commercial / legal tie-ins:
- SPW that commits to feature delivery milestones (3 checkpoints) over 6 months.
- SPW accepted only if Keyframe signs a 12-month committed Dedicated capacity or an enterprise contract (standard for roadmap commitments).
- Offer a one-time implementation credit if they sign a 12-month Dedicated contract.

Questions for you:
1) Are you comfortable authorizing a product roadmap commitment (SPW) for this deal conditional on a Dedicated/enterprise contract?
2) Are there limits we should include (e.g., cap on engineering hours, scope exclusions)?

Need a reply by EOD 3/19 to keep on track for their 3/24 SLA.

Thanks — Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for SPW commitment to Keyframe Health (audit logging)

Monica — authorize the SPW approach with the following firm guardrails:

- SPW to commit to three milestone dates within 6 months from contract signature. Milestones must be measurable (API to export logs, retention configuration toggle, and verification report).
- SPW acceptance is conditional on Keyframe signing a 12-month Dedicated or enterprise agreement and agreeing to a modest implementation fee that covers priority scheduling.
- Cap engineering hours at a mutually agreed number (to be specified by Product) and exclude non-core integrations (e.g., custom SIEM integrations beyond standard export).

Lauren: please convert the SPW template into a legally binding exhibit and include fallback language if timelines slip (e.g., alternative compensating control period).

Monica: proceed with Neha to finalize answers and produce the final SIG packet; attach SPW draft and send to Keyframe with the conditional language.

Aditya Rao
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Olivia / Keyframe team — thanks for the patience. Attached are our completed SIG answers and a draft Statement of Planned Work (SPW) covering extended audit logging and retention. Summary: 

- For audit logging retention (Q8.1) we are providing a conditional SPW committing to delivery milestones within 6 months of contract signature. The SPW is conditioned on Keyframe executing a 12-month Dedicated or enterprise agreement and agreeing to the implementation schedule and fee outlined in the SPW.
- For encryption key custody (Q5.3) we confirm customer-managed keys are available on Dedicated/Private. For hosted, we noted the difference and provided options.
- For the telemetry subprocessors (Q4.2) we propose a compensating control (feature-flagged telemetry and contractual certification).
- Backup retention and extended restores are available as a commercial add-on; details in the attachment.

Attachments: Keyframe_SIG_answers_final.pdf; SPW_Keyframe_SIG_commitment.docx

Next steps: please review the packet and let us know if you'd like a call to walk through the SPW language. If you accept the SPW conditions, we will include the SPW as an exhibit in the enterprise contract.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
